title: Binding
description: Where and how one interaction is served (§4.2, §9.6.1). A client reaches an interaction only through a binding its profile or the bootstrap serves, and picks the first it supports, in the order given; it never builds an address.

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

protocol.description: How the interaction travels. `sse` and `wss` are reserved for a later minor version (§9.6.5).

server.description: A server the bootstrap names in `servers`; the interaction's URL is that server's `url` followed by `address` (§9.6.1).

address.description: A path (beginning with `/` for https), channel or topic.

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

method.description: For https: the HTTP method. Every atlas/1.0 interaction binding declares POST (§9.6.2).

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

encodings.description: The encodings this binding serves, in its preference order (§9.6.4).

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

auth.description: How the caller authenticates: its sign-in (`bearer`), its own token for the system (`entra-scope`), or a credential the gateway issued (`ticket`).

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

delivery.description: The delivery this binding answers with, where it differs from its interaction's (a fallback that answers an operation for a stream, §2.1.D; Q-DOC-4).
